detail: hbox native-set-bdd4f40c4-r2 logs test-tests.test_native_over_pins.log (+ stderr/test-tests.test_native_over_pins/*idle-article*): the fixture is now sound (b89f433f6 funds the 12 MiB article: accepted post path=served 17:59:23Z) but at 17:59:32Z the reader connects, sends ARTICLE with SO_RCVBUF=4096, sleeps 5 s, and client.line() (tests/native_harness.py:1409 recv) times out at 300 s: the node never writes the first reply line and never closes. Same module's OVER tests pass. Unconfirmed hypotheses, in order: (1) the window/cold route has no path for one payload larger than the decoded-window storage (4 DECODED-WINDOW slots, extent.lisp:815) or the realizer cache, so the line is re-run forever as in sl-cold-line-deadline's mechanism; (2) the exposure idle/first-line deadlines (set to 3 s by the test) defer the connection while the client is not reading and the refresh-on-progress never fires because no output was accepted yet. First move: run the one test on lat1 with FN_NATIVE_OWNER_TEST_PIPELINE_TRACE and read the node's stderr while the client waits; try the same ARTICLE with a normal SO_RCVBUF and a 1 MiB / 4 MiB / 12 MiB payload to separate (1) from (2).
fix: Undiagnosed; this is a diagnosis item, not a ready fix. Owner of the cold-line/window route should take it.

ROOT RULING: (a) profile-derived window 256 KiB, bulk span borrow, (c) verified streaming ledgered, (d) rejected.
